description: Core discovery tool. Use when the buyer asks for examples such as 'who has made a 6061-T6 medical endoscope housing to ±0.01 mm' or wants factories with experience in an industry. Returns work title, material, process, industry, tolerance, images and canonical source URL, plus supplier context. Results are newest-first. Works without English/published projection are excluded.

industry.description: Industry cluster or detail substring, e.g. aerospace or medical.

material.description: Single material substring; alias for materials.

materials.description: Material substrings; any match is accepted.

tolerance_max_mm.description: Only return works with declared tolerance at or below this value in mm.

name: search_works
